test_title: PYST 33: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which organisation typically supports the implementation of the 'Sports and Games for the Disabled' scheme?

options.text: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** is the primary nodal agency in **India** responsible for the formulation and implementation of policies related to sports development, including the specialized scheme for **Sports and Games for the Disabled**.
 
• The main objective of this scheme is to promote **broad-basing of sports** among **differently-abled** persons (**Divyangjan**) by providing them with opportunities to participate in competitive sports and physical activities.
 
• Under this initiative, the **Government of India** provides financial assistance for the organization of **National Coaching Camps**, procurement of specialized sports equipment, and the conduct of **State and National level competitions**.
 
• The scheme specifically targets three categories of disabled athletes: the **Orthopedically Impaired**, the **Visually Impaired**, and those with **Intellectual Disabilities** (formerly referred to as Mentally Retallenged).
 
• The implementation is carried out through various specialized sports bodies such as the **Paralympic Committee of India (PCI)**, **Special Olympics Bharat**, and the **All India Sports Council of the Deaf (AISCD)**, all of which receive grants from the **Ministry**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Integration with Khelo India:**
 
 
• In recent years, the standalone scheme for the disabled has been integrated as a specific vertical under the **Khelo India - National Programme for Development of Sports**.
 
• This vertical, titled **"Promotion of sports among persons with disabilities,"** ensures a more streamlined flow of **funds** and better **infrastructure** access for para-athletes across the **country**.
 
 
 
• **Role of Sports Authority of India (SAI):**
 
 
• The **Sports Authority of India**, an autonomous body under the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, provides the necessary technical support and **training facilities** for athletes selected under these schemes.
 
• **SAI** centers across **India** are increasingly becoming **barrier-free** to accommodate the unique needs of disabled sports persons.
 
 
 
• **International Participation:**
 
 
• The ministry facilitates the participation of Indian contingents in major international events such as the **Paralympic Games**, **Asian Para Games**, and the **Special Olympics World Games**.
 
• Financial support for international exposure is provided through the **Scheme of Assistance to National Sports Federations (NSFs)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Legislative Context:** The promotion of sports for the disabled aligns with the mandates of the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016**, which emphasizes **equality** and **non-discrimination** in the fields of culture, leisure, and **sports**.
 
• **Annual Calendar of Training and Competitions (ACTC):** The **Ministry** approves a specific **ACTC** for para-sports every **year**, ensuring that athletes have a fixed schedule for **training** and **tournaments** with dedicated **budgets**.
 
• **Recognition:** Successful para-athletes are eligible for prestigious national honors such as the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** and the **Arjuna Award**, further incentivizing excellence in **disabled sports**.
 
• **Cash Incentives:** Under the **Scheme of Special Awards**, the **Ministry** grants significant **monetary rewards** to medal winners at international championships to recognize their **achievements** and provide **financial security**.
</ul
